reviews.title: Great monitor!
reviews.comment: Bought this wonderful monitor for a second monitor to my laptop and Wow! What took me so long. I bought the HDMI version which plugged into my Dell laptop perfectly and near seamlessly. The monitor has it's own speakers which have decent sound compared to my laptop. Sadly the near only takeaway is that it that it does not have a camera in it so the have video calls one needs to look into the laptop cam and not the main monitor. Resolution is fab. Footprint is elegant and it was priced right. I love it and would recommend it to any of my friends.
reviews.author: Terry Rich

reviews.title: Great monitor for the speed and resolution they are
reviews.comment: Really nice monitor for the price. These have a speaker and sound is reasonable for what it is. I run two of these on an arm, the bezel is thin enough where they look great. Highly recommend these for a good monitor fitting the speed and resolution.
reviews.author: Big D
